title: Gopi Kishan
desc: Policeman Gopi's doppelganger Kishan, who is a criminal, learns about the former and uses his identity to his advantage as he tries to find his father. This results in Gopi reaping the benefits.

title: Game Changer
desc: A principled IAS officer battles systemic corruption, championing fair elections to uphold democratic integrity amidst political machinations.

title: Ravan Raaj: A True Story
desc: Former ACP Arjun Verma is reinstated to investigate the abductions of a few women in the city. To his horror, he discovers the skeletal remains of the abducted women.

title: Narsimha
desc: Narasimha, an assassin, works for Bapji, a powerful thug, and kills people on his behalf. However, things take a turn when he is ordered to murder Ravi, and he declines to follow the order.
